name: Editions Coffee Shop & Bookstore
tagline: Books, brews, and yarn in a 1920s mill house downtown
story: Owner Dawn Evans runs a bookstore, coffee shop and yarn room in a former mill house built in the early 1920s. Selling yarn is her way of bringing textiles back to the home of Cannon Mills.

hours.note: Fridays 5–7 pm the shop hosts a private event (Writer's Block); the drive-thru stays open until 7.

coffee.roaster: Coffee from Fortuna Enterprises, a Greensboro, NC roaster (since 2000): house blends, flavored blends and espresso.

menu.items: Drip and iced drip, espresso, Americano, latte, mocha, cappuccino, dirty chai, Red Eye. Drip refill $0.95.
Iced latte, mocha, Americano, caramel macchiato, iced dirty chai (a local favorite)
Slow-steeped cold brew and nitro cold brew, S–XL
Caramel, chocolate, java chip, matcha, cookies & cream, vanilla bean and more, S–XL
Real-fruit smoothies (mango, berry, peach, pineapple and more) and lightly caffeinated refreshers: Strawberry Acai, Dragonfruit Elderberry
Plant-based energy drinks: Lotus Tea, Lotus Lemonade, Specialty Lotus (M, L, XL)
Hot chocolate, matcha, chai, bagged teas, kids milk (12 oz)

addons.what: Oat, almond, coconut or soy milk
Whip, sweet cream or cold foam

yarn.pitch: A craft room for beginners and experts alike: yarn, needles, hooks and accessories, plus knitting and crochet classes.
returns: Returns and exchanges within 30 days with receipt, in original, salable condition.
Wound yarn, gift cards and discounted items are final sale.
Dye lots vary. Match multiple skeins before you buy.
Patterns, needles, hooks and tools can't be returned but are replaced if defective.

events.title: Holiday Closure
details: We'll be closed on Thanksgiving Day to spend time with our loved ones. We're so thankful for our incredible Editions community and hope you have a wonderful holiday!

events.title: Black Friday Weekend Savings
details: Your holiday shopping just got a little more bookish! Join us for THREE days of special savings on books, yarn, tumblers, candles, and more! Whether you're shopping for the readers, makers, or coffee lovers on your list (or treating yourself!), we've got something for everyone.
Stay tuned for all the details on our Black Friday weekend specials!

details: All aspiring authors are welcome to join and collaborate with fellow writers!
